description: Security vulnerabilities with a CVE id named in today's stories.

cve_id.description: The CVE id exactly as written, e.g. CVE-2026-125396.

product.description: The affected program or library, short.

packages.description: Package names a developer would find in a project, by ecosystem; empty if none is named or obvious.

affected.description: Affected versions as the story states them; empty if not stated.

fixed_in.description: The first fixed version as the story states it; empty if no fix is named.

severity_article.description: Only when the story gives a rating or a CVSS score.

agent_text.description: Polish Markdown for an agent: '### Jak wykryć' and '### Co zrobić'.

story_ref.description: The story's ref from the input, e.g. 2026-11-22#3.
